title: Simple Sailing
description: An optimized pack with shaders and functional ships.
body: Simple Sailing is a lightweight, high-performance pack that transforms the world into a vast, endless ocean dotted with small islands via a custom world-gen datapack. Using the mods Valkyrien Skies and Eureka, you can turn any structure into a fully functional, physics-based ship to explore the endless ocean. With the Valkyrien Pirates mod, there are several enemy ships that will spawn throughout the world for you to fight, raid, and loot. Using several performance mods (Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore), and a lightweight shader pack (MakeUp UltraFast), you can achieve 60fps on almost any modern hardware.
